## Configuration and reproduction

- GPT-6 Luna: [`configs/ecom_agentic/agentic_ecom_2tools_e5_gpt6_luna.yml`](../../configs/ecom_agentic/agentic_ecom_2tools_e5_gpt6_luna.yml)
- SID-2 low: [`configs/ecom_sid/agentic_ecom_sid_bm25_e5_base_v2_low.yml`](../../configs/ecom_sid/agentic_ecom_sid_bm25_e5_base_v2_low.yml)
- Both variants use BM25 and E5-base-v2; SID-2 uses low reasoning effort.
- The full ESCI judgments contain 130,652 queries. This report uses the same 1,000-query sample and seed as the existing ESCI matrix because the full query set is substantially larger.
- Run `uv run python scripts/generate_esci_gpt6_sid_low_report.py` to regenerate from the cached matrix sample. The generator verifies all cache batches before running and will not start fresh model calls.
